first_public_date_evidence: The 2007-09-05 first-posted date is verified for arXiv:0709.0707. The directly inspected Rublev–Petunin volume is dated August 1998, but an exact earliest public day could not be established; no day is inferred from that month.
scientific_integrity: Analytical contact criterion and explicit positive weights prove the general claim; finite diagnostics are corroborative rather than exhaustive proof. Related general-polygon algorithms and quadrature theory are credited. Publication-priority uncertainty is explicit.
scientific_limitations: Only consecutive-block deletion from a regular planar \(n\)-gon with \(n\ge6\) and \(1\le k\le n-3\) is classified. The optimizer beyond the sharp threshold and arbitrary separated erasures are not determined. Independent historical priority and independent validation remain outstanding.
title: Sharp one-third erasure threshold for the Löwner ellipse of a regular polygon
